text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Emerging victorious in the Japan Cup
is Hishi Amazon, the "Heroine" Hishi Amazon!
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, what the... what is that running?!
The sheer intensity is unreal, I've got goosebumps...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Narita Brian after crossing the finish line...
Didn't she have this, like... intense glare?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks a bunch!
...Still, the opponent I really wanna face is—
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian! Perfect timing,
I had business with you too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Winning first made me realize something.
I went all out in a real one-on-one today,
but still, it just wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No one less than you
would be fit to be my rival."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting, so hurry up and climb.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...
...Yeah, you don't need to tell me twice.

Narita Brian's sharp eyes
glinted with a dull, beast-like sheen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I have always chased after my sister's back.
I kept dreaming of that back I could never quite reach.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "A distant back that stays out of reach no matter how hard I chase it, leaving behind a longing and a fiery passion that never cools..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Today—right here, that back was before me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I'll overtake you for sure.
At the Arima Kinen, I won't let you have the victory.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
I see, I see...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's how it should be...!
Next up is finally the Arima Kinen—!
